notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for ordinary object-removal fan-out. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies object registration and discovery followed by two ordinary deleteObjectInstance operations delivered to two active subscribers in producer order, that the owner receives no loopback removal, and that object, user tag, and producing-federate metadata are preserved for each subscriber. Timestamped removal, regions/DDM, custom transportation, MOM, save/restore, and provider-private behavior remain outside this contract.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador object-class lookup, publication, active subscription, object registration, ordinary Delete Object Instance, unsubscription, unpublication, resignation, and disconnect services with FederateAmbassador discovery and ordinary removal callbacks
